channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Python Workers are now generally available
item.description: Python Workers allow developers to run Python web frameworks and AI orchestration libraries natively in the Cloudflare Workers runtime. (2 sources: cloudflare, hackernews)

item.title: Uber Redesigns M3DB Sharding with Subclusters to Limit Failure Impact
item.description: Uber has redesigned shard placement in M3DB with fixed size subclusters to limit the impact of node failures, maintenance, and cluster scaling. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Squalk: an old-school forum engine built on Nostr (NIP-29 groups, NIP-7D threads)
item.description: I miss classic forums: slow, asynchronous threads that stay readable and searchable for years, instead of knowledge dissolving into chat scrollback. (1 source: lobsters)
